allow_networks.description: List of network ranges allowed to query this NTP server. Each entry is an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR or address.

fallback_servers.description: List of NTP servers to use as fallback when GPS is unavailable. Each entry must specify 'hostname'. Optionally 'prefer' to prioritize the server.

pps_enabled.description: Enable PPS (pulse-per-second) signal input for sub-microsecond accuracy. Requires hardware PPS support and /dev/pps0.

restrict_enabled.description: Enable restrictive NTP access rules to prevent unauthorized queries, modifications, and attacks.

serve_enabled.description: Enable this host to serve time to clients. Sets local stratum to 10 for fallback GPS/PPS operation.

source_selection.description: Primary time source(s). Typically a pool or specific servers. 'gps' is added automatically via refclocks; this is for fallback NTP sources.
